text: Don't be stupid. So much of life is all about doing more of what works. If you went on a diet and that diet worked, go on the diet again. If you went to a certain place and then you met a girl there, do that again. If you did a certain business or a certain way of getting customers that got you a lot of leads, do it again and do more of it. Stop doing the things that don't work and do more of the things that do work.
